column1: # These rows point at solutions that already live elsewhere in the repository.
# Nothing is copied into practice/: `ol start reattempt` reads the file in
# place, strips the region between its solution markers, and writes the result
# into .scratchpad/. So there is exactly one copy of every solution, and it is
# the one the learning path already links to.
# A source only belongs here if it asserts something. A file that defines a
# function and never calls it exits zero whether it is correct or blank, which
# would make `ol check` pass an empty stub and be worse than having no exercise.
# Columns: track <TAB> name <TAB> path relative to the repo root
# algorithms/ is deliberately empty for now. Those files are LeetCode-shaped:
# they define a function and assert nothing, so they cannot be checked. Adding
